description: When a task needs a key or password from the user (an API key, a login), create a one-time secure link for it. Give the link to the user; they type the value there and it goes straight to their 5dive server, where the task's agent can use it. You never see the value: never ask the user to type a key or password in this chat.

ask.description: One plain sentence for the user: what it is and where they find it.

key.description: The key's name in capitals, e.g. STRIPE_API_KEY.

task.description: The task that needs the key, e.g. DIVE-123.

name: secrets_request
